svg.text: AI counter rate per match: memory ON vs OFF
Share of the bot human's moves the AI met with the move that beats it. Each point = mean of 200 independent series (same seeds both conditions), 95% CI band.

N = 200 series x 20 matches = 4000 matches per persona per condition (32000 total, 198 with no human move excluded). Dashed gray = shuffle-chance baseline. Generated by learning/batch.mjs + chart.mjs.
